senses.gloss:
लुभ् I. €6 P. To bewilder, confound, perplex. ━II. €4 P. (लुभ्यति, लुब्ध)
—1 To covet, long for, desire eagerly (with dat. or loc.); तथापि रामो
 लुलुभे मृगाय.
—2 To allure, entice.
—3 To be bewidered or perplexed, go astray. ━Caus. (लोभयति-ते)
—1 To make greedy, cause to long for, produce or excite desire for; पुप्लुवे
 बहु लोभयन् Bk. 5. 48.
—2 To excite lust.
—3 To entice, seduce, allure,
[]
 attract; लोभ्यमाननयनः श्लथांशुकैर्मेखलागुणपदैर्नितम्बिभिः R. 19. 26.
—4 To derange, disorder, disturb.
लुभित p. p. Perplexed, disturbed; P. VII. 2. 54.
